newsitem.title: USA: Emery names Quantrill as v-p international.
newsitem.headline: Emery names Quantrill as v-p international.

text.p: REDWOOD CITY, Calif, July 28, 1997 - Emery Worldwide, said it appointed Peter Quantrill as vice president - international.
Quantrill will be responsibile for the company's four operating areas covering Asia/Pacific; Europe, including the United Kingdom, Middle East and Africa; Japan; and Latin America.
The company said in a statement that he succeeds Chutta Ratnathicam, who was recently named senior vice-president and chief financial officer of Emery's parent compnay, CNF Transportation Inc.
